accounting_framework: IFRS (Commercial Companies Law FDL 32/2021; Ministerial Decision 114/2023: IFRS required, IFRS for SMEs permitted below AED 50m revenue; cash basis below AED 3m). English filings standard.

default_tax_line.label: Taxes
default_tax_line.basis: Federal Corporate Tax 9% (FDL 47/2022, FYs from June 2023) on taxable income above AED 375,000; 0% band below. Flat 9% on EBT slightly overstates tax for small profits - acceptable simplification above ~AED 2m EBT.

tax_recipes.small_business_relief: Revenue <= AED 3m per year (periods ending on/before 31 Dec 2026): may elect Small Business Relief - treated as having no taxable income; set tax_pct_ebt = 0 and disclose the sunset.
tax_recipes.band_exact: For precision near the band: tax_pct_ebt(year) = 0.09 * max(0, EBT - 375) / EBT (EBT in AED '000) - compute per year and set explicitly.
tax_recipes.free_zone: Qualifying Free Zone Person: 0% on qualifying income, 9% on non-qualifying (de minimis: lower of 5% of revenue or AED 5m; MD 229/2025 defines qualifying/excluded activities). Set a blended effective rate and disclose.
tax_recipes.pillar_two: DMTT 15% (Cabinet Decision 142/2024) for FYs from 1 Jan 2025, MNE groups >= EUR 750m (2-of-4 test). Use 0.15 effective if in scope.

vat_note: VAT 5% since 2018 (mandatory registration above AED 375,000; FDL 16/2025 amended the VAT law without changing the rate). AR/AP balances may be VAT-inclusive.
fiscal_year_note: Any 12-month financial year; CT return + payment within 9 months of period end. AED pegged at 3.6725/USD.
depreciation_note: No general statutory tax-depreciation schedule; accounting depreciation generally follows IFRS and is deductible (MD 173/2025 caps investment-property depreciation at 4% of cost where the realisation basis is elected).
pillar_two_note: DMTT 15% in force for large MNE groups from FY2025; first returns due 2027.
disclosure: Tax modeled as 9% of earnings before tax - a simplification of the AED 375,000 0% band, Small Business Relief, free-zone regimes and the DMTT; not tax advice. Statements per IFRS.
